title: DevSuperSuite Disaster Recovery & RPO/RTO Multi-Region Failover Evidence

steps.name: Anomaly Detection & Health Probing
steps.details: Synthetic probes detected 3 consecutive HTTP 503 failures on primary API gateway.

steps.name: Quorum Consensus & Split-Brain Prevention
steps.details: Raft quorum verified with 3/3 healthy nodes. Consensus reached to promote standby.

steps.name: Primary Region Demotion & STONITH Fencing
steps.details: STONITH isolation enforced on us-east-1. Network ingress revoked, prevent split-brain dual writes.

steps.name: Database Replica Promotion & Write Lock Release
steps.details: us-west-2 promoted from READ_REPLICA to READ_WRITE_MASTER. WAL offset synchronized. 0 records lost.

steps.name: KMS Envelope Key Re-binding & Enclave Attestation
steps.details: AWS KMS multi-region key replica bound to us-west-2 Nitro Enclave with hardware attestation.

steps.name: GeoDNS / Route53 Latency Routing Weight Flip
steps.details: Route53 DNS weights flipped: us-east-1 (100 -> 0), us-west-2 (0 -> 100). Edge caches invalidated.

steps.name: Verification of End-to-End Traffic Resumption
steps.details: Synthetic checkout transactions verified against new us-west-2 primary. Latency: 28ms.

chaos_engineering_matrix.name: Primary Region Network Partition (Split-Brain Prevention)
chaos_engineering_matrix.description: Simulated total transit gateway network partition isolating primary region us-east-1.
chaos_engineering_matrix.mitigation_applied: Raft quorum consensus detected partition (2/3 quorum). Executed STONITH fencing on us-east-1 and promoted us-west-2.

chaos_engineering_matrix.name: Cloud KMS Key Rotation Outage & Fallback
chaos_engineering_matrix.description: Simulated KMS key management rotation RPC timeout and HSM endpoint unreachability.
chaos_engineering_matrix.mitigation_applied: Transparent fallback to local Hardware Enclave envelope DEK cache with zero secret exposure.

chaos_engineering_matrix.name: Primary Database Crash & Zero-Loss Replica Promotion
chaos_engineering_matrix.description: Simulated kernel panic and crash of active PostgreSQL / Aurora primary master instance.
chaos_engineering_matrix.mitigation_applied: Aurora multi-region auto-promotion promoted us-west-2 read replica with zero data loss.

chaos_engineering_matrix.name: DNS Routing Blackhole & Latency Routing Flip
chaos_engineering_matrix.description: Simulated BGP route blackhole and DNS resolver failure on primary ingress endpoint.
chaos_engineering_matrix.mitigation_applied: Automated synthetic Route53 health checks failed 3/3; flipped traffic weight 100%% to us-west-2.
